remarks: Spacious Townhouse in convenient location, just s short walk to the train, Harbor Point Restaurants, Shops and vibrant Downtown Stamford. This unit built in 2006 has been freshly painted throughout and features an open floor plan with a sunny Living Room open to a large Eat-in Kitchen with brand new stainless appliances and quartz countertops. There is also a full bath on this level. Upstairs includes the Primary Bedroom with walk-in closet, plus two additional bedrooms with double closets, and a hall full bath. There is also a pull-down attic for storage, a large two car garage with laundry and storage closets. Good credit and references a must! No Pets or smoking. First month's rent plus two month's security.
